title: Report-shape pauses: name the real defect, feed it back to the role, and cap the retry loop
lead: *Proposed.* A report-shape failure no longer repeats silently. (1) The shape error says what is actually wrong with an `[owner]` finding: today one message ("needs Options: ... and Recommend: N - reason, directly under its tag line") covers every defect, including the case where Options and Recommend are present and an extra detail line follows (S288 makes that case valid). (2) The rerun's brief carries that exact error and the text of the offending finding, not only the finding's title. (3) ork counts consecutive shape pauses for the same role and round. At the second one the pause names the refused report file, points at `ork show RUN` (S297), and offers a way past: `ork retry RUN --accept-shape`, which keeps an owner finding that has no options as a plain open owner finding (or, for `[owner blocker]`, as a free-text question) and spends no role round. Owner decisions, 2026-11-05 (interactive interview, all recommended options): the second consecutive shape pause of one role and round is the capped one (Q4 two); after the cap a plain `ork retry RUN` is refused with one line naming `ork show RUN`, `ork retry RUN --accept-shape`, `ork retry RUN --again` (one more rerun on purpose) and `ork stop RUN` (Q1 refuse-plain-retry); a shape-failing owner finding is accepted without options only with `--accept-shape`, chosen by the owner after the cap, never by default (Q2 never-by-default); S288 builds first and owns the parser and prompt change for detail lines (kept in `Finding.Text` after `Recommend:`), one leading list marker and the prompt rule with a refused and an accepted example, so this slice keeps only the specific error text, the feedback to the role, the cap and the accept flag, and its tests are written against the parser as S288 leaves it (Q3 s288-first). This slice depends on S288.
findings_note: 2026-11-05, prism-ui: run ork-20261105-173816-e0c2 (U32) paused on report shape three times in a row; each ork retry re-ran the reviewer (about 3 minutes, three rounds) and the next report failed the same check. Cause: an [owner] finding fails if any line besides Options, the options and Recommend sits under its tag (internal/engine/kinds.go:133-187 into internal/engine/report.go:182-240: 5 to 7 lines, Recommend last), and the error text says Options and Recommend are missing when they are present. Nothing counts or caps consecutive shape pauses. Related: S297 (show the report), S294, S275, S287, S288.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the parser and prompt change for detail lines, list markers and prose under an owner finding (S288, which builds first; owner decision 2026-11-05); the one automatic retry for a malformed report that also asks the owner (S287); the spec check's own retry (S266); the command that prints a report (S297); implementer fix rounds on a red check (S294, which this slice resembles but does not change); a second automatic retry; changing `CheckReport`'s other rules or the budget pause.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner evidence, 2026-11-05 (prism-ui; run `ork-20261105-173816-e0c2`, item U32): the run paused on report shape three times in a row. Per the coordinator, who read the reviewer's reports of that run with the owner's permission: in attempts 1 to 3 the owner findings had `Options:` and `Recommend:` correctly formed, and each was followed by 1 to 3 indented detail bullets; every attempt failed; about three minutes and three reviewer rounds went on it. I did not read the run directory. What follows is what the code at HEAD of main (`6a45b77`) does, read on 2026-11-05.

The defect and its message:

- `segment.finding` (`internal/engine/kinds.go:133-187`) dedents every line under an `[owner]` tag (`:138`), drops blank lines and one `Decision key:` line, and passes the rest, behind `Question: TITLE`, to `parseOwnerQuestion` (`:181`).
- `parseOwnerQuestion` (`internal/engine/report.go:182-240`) needs 5 to 7 lines in all (`len(lines) < 5 || len(lines) > 7`, `:210`): `Question:`, `Options:`, 2 to 4 option lines of the form `N. label: summary` (`optionLine`, `:176`, checked at `:215-225`) and `Recommend: N - reason` as the last line (`recommendLine`, `:177`, checked at `:232`). A detail line anywhere else fails: after Recommend it is read as an option line or, when it is the last line, as the Recommend line (`:232`), and with three of them the count passes 7 (`:210`).
- Every failure returns the same text: `bad()` (`:211`, `:215`, `:221`, `:225`, `:232`, `:237`) gives "Owner needed requires Question: title, Options: ... and Recommend: N - reason", and `finding` replaces it with its own sentence (`internal/engine/kinds.go:183`): `owner finding "TITLE" needs Options: with 2 to 4 numbered unique labels and summaries, and Recommend: N - reason, directly under its tag line`. For a finding that has all of them, that sentence is false. The finding's body and the offending line are not in it, only the title.
- The role has no way to know the rule. The reviewer prompt says "Indent every line that belongs to a finding under its tag line" (`internal/roles/prompts/reviewer.md:75`; the same sentence is at `gate.md:65` and `ui.md:122`) and shows no line after `Recommend:` (`reviewer.md:83-87`), but never says that nothing may follow it. S288 (filed, owner answers recorded 2026-11-04, not built) is the fix for the parser and the prompts; owner decision 2026-11-05 (Q3 s288-first): it builds before this slice.

How the retries work (the question the owner asked):

- The check runs in `runRound` after the role ends: `CheckReport`, then `Triage` or `TriageGate` for reviewer, UI pass and gate (`internal/engine/round.go:499-531`). Problems from both are joined into one `ShapeError` (`internal/engine/report.go:96-100`; `Triage` collects every finding's problem, `:370-429`, so two bad findings give two sentences).
- On a problem (`internal/engine/round.go:533`) ork builds a pause of kind `shape` whose reason is the joined text (`:535-536`). It retries the role once by itself when the report has no `## Owner needed` question and no valid owner finding, and the previous context was not already a shape pause for this role and round (`:541-542`). That is the one automatic retry of S275: same round, same session, no implementer round used. Any other case, including the rerun that fails again, pauses (`:551`).
- `ork retry RUN` runs the role again (`internal/engine/engine.go:470-520`; the daemon refuses a run that is not paused and a question pause, `internal/daemon/runs.go:1015-1025`). Because the retried context is a shape pause for the same role and round, the rerun gets no automatic retry (`internal/engine/round.go:542`): the next shape failure pauses at once. Each operator retry is therefore one full role round, and nothing counts them. No counter or limit on shape pauses exists: `runrec.PendingShape` is referenced only at `internal/engine/round.go:143`, `:274`, `:535` and `:542`.
- Is the error fed back? Yes, in part. The resumed round gets a "Report shape" brief section: "ork checked your last report and refused it: REASON ... Write the report again" (`internal/engine/round.go:143-144`; the section builder at `internal/engine/round.go:125-134`, used when the brief is built at `:292`). REASON is the joined error text, so the role sees the generic sentence and the finding title. It does not see the finding's own lines or which rule they broke. The session is resumed only when the same vendor and model ran the role before (latestSession, `:48-55`, called at `:277` with the role allowed after a shape or question pause, `:274-276`); on another lineup row the role starts without its earlier report in view, with only the sentence. Earlier attempts' reports stay on disk under distinct names (`internal/engine/round.go:247-257`), but the brief does not include them.
- The report names are in the record (`internal/engine/round.go:428-449`), so S297's `ork show RUN NAME` can print the refused report. Without it an agent cannot read it (S297 Why).
- Answers: `ork answer` does not work on a shape pause (`docs/guide.md:408`), and `ork retry RUN TEXT` sends only a note to the rerun (S256), so the owner today has no way to accept the report as it is.

Relation to S294 (rounds without progress; *proposed*, read 2026-11-05): S294 stops silent looping of implementer fix rounds on a red check, by pausing after round 3 with `ork retry RUN [--rounds N]`, and pauses at once when the worktree and the check output repeat byte for byte. This slice follows the same rule, no silent loops on an identical failure, for a different failure. Differences: the failing thing is a report's shape, not the work or a check; shape reruns are not implementer rounds and S275 decided they use none (`docs/design.md:570-584`), so S294's round counter does not see them; the roles that loop here are mostly read-only (reviewer, UI pass, gate, architect), so there is no worktree fingerprint to compare and the proof of "no progress" is that the same check fails again; the way past is not more rounds but accepting the report as it stands. The cap covers every reporting role because the branch is shared (`internal/engine/round.go:533-551`), the implementer's own report shape included. Related: S275 (the one automatic retry; landed), S287 (extend that retry to a malformed report that also asks the owner; filed), S288 (owner finding body rule; filed), S266 (spec check version), S297 (show the report).

Check before specifying (AGENTS.md rule): the owner-finding body rule and the shape check are ork's own (`roles.prompts`, adj 58 `role.report-shape`). `slicer --root ../slicer find "report shape"` (2026-11-05) returned only s296 and s304, which name report shape as part of the relay contract text, not a check slicer runs on ork's role reports; `find "owner finding"` returned only s403 (approval and landing steps). So slicer does not provide this.

Not verified: that a shape pause is recorded the same way when the reviewer and the UI pass fail at once (two roles, one pending slot; `docs/state.md:262-292` describes `shape_retry` on role records for that case). The counter below must live where each role's context survives that; settle at the build. Also not verified: that the TUI renders a finding with no `ask`.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/kinds.go:133-187` (`finding`: build the specific message at `:181-184`; keep the title in it).
- `internal/engine/report.go:182-240` (parseOwnerQuestion: return which rule failed and the line; keep the "Owner needed requires" prefix that `internal/engine/report_test.go:403` checks, and keep `bad()` callers at `:151` and `:276` working).
- `internal/engine/round.go:136-149` (the Report shape brief: add the finding text), `:532-551` (the shape branch: the counter and the cap pause text), `:247-277` (attempt report names, session reuse; the brief must not depend on the session).
- `internal/runrec/record.go:154-176` (Pending: a shape_pauses counter, and the refused finding text for the brief; names to settle at the build; no strict-key problem for old readers is claimed, see `docs/state.md:282-283`).
- `internal/engine/engine.go:470-520` (RetryNote: an accept-shape variant; no role runs) and `internal/engine/later.go:18-26` (questionText dereferences its argument, so a blocker with no `ask` needs its own text path) and `:36-61` (`recordFindings`: an owner finding with no `ask` is stored).
- `internal/daemon/runs.go:63-75` (`RunAction`: `accept_shape` and `again` flags), `:1015-1025` (`MethodRunRetry`: refuse a plain retry at the cap; owner decision 2026-11-05, Q1), `:1308-1322` (the `next:` hint for the capped pause).
- `internal/cli/run.go:216-271` (`ork retry RUN [TEXT] [--accept-shape]`), `internal/cli/cli.go:44` (usage text).
- Tests: `internal/engine/kinds_report_test.go` (beside `TestTriageRefusesMalformedNonFixFindings`, `:140`), `internal/engine/kinds_test.go` (beside `TestMalformedOwnerFindingPausesOnAShapeError`, `:205`), `internal/engine/round_test.go` (beside `TestAutomaticShapeRetryDoesNotUseARound`, `:190`, and `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionStillPausesForTheOwner`, `:245`), `internal/daemon/retry_test.go` (beside `TestRunRetryCarriesTheText`, `:88`), `internal/cli/retry_test.go`.
- Docs: `docs/design.md:570-584` (Report checks), `docs/state.md:262-292` (pending kinds), `docs/guide.md:408` (the paused-run table), `CHANGELOG.md` (one *proposed* entry).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/kinds_report_test.go`, with the `review` helper:

- `TestOwnerFindingErrorNamesTheRealDefect` (table; each case's message contains the title and the named fact; cases written against the parser as S288 leaves it): no `Options:` line says so; one option says "needs 2 to 4 options, has 1"; option 2 written `3. x: y` names the number it expected; an option line with no `: summary` quotes the line; no `Recommend:` line says so; `Recommend: 5 - x` with 2 options names the range. Fails first: all return the one sentence at `internal/engine/kinds.go:183`.
- `TestOwnerFindingErrorIsNotFalse`: a finding that has `Options:` and `Recommend:` never gets the words "needs Options". Fails first: it does.
- S288 lands first (owner decision 2026-11-05, Q3) and accepts detail lines after `Recommend:` and one leading list marker, so this table has no detail-line or list-marker case; a guard case checks that a block with one detail line after `Recommend:` is accepted.
- Guard: the existing malformed-finding table test (`internal/engine/kinds_report_test.go:140`) still refuses every case, and `internal/engine/report_test.go:403` still sees "Owner needed requires".

In `internal/engine/round_test.go`, with `newHarness` (`internal/engine/harness_test.go:195`):

- `TestShapeRetryBriefCarriesTheCauseAndTheFindingText`: a reviewer report with an owner finding whose option 2 is numbered `3.`, then a good one. The second request's "Report shape" section holds the specific cause and the finding's lines. Fails first: the generic sentence and the title.
- `TestShapeRetryBriefHoldsWithoutAResumableSession`: the same with a lineup whose second row is another vendor, so no session is resumed. The brief still holds the finding's lines. Fails first: title only.
- `TestShapePauseCounterCountsConsecutivePausesOfOneRoleAndRound`: reviewer fails on the automatic retry (pause 1, `shape_pauses` 1), `RetryNote`, fails again (pause 2, count 2). A clean report ends the count; so does a different role or round.
- `TestSecondShapePauseNamesTheReportAndTheWayPast`: at pause 2 the reason names the refused report file (`reviewer-1-attempt-3.md`), `ork show RUN`, and `ork retry RUN --accept-shape`. Fails first: the plain reason.
- `TestFirstShapePauseIsUnchanged`: pause 1 reason is the plain error plus the specific cause (no accept hint). Guard.
- `TestAcceptShapeKeepsAnOwnerFindingWithoutOptions`: at the cap, `RetryNote` with accept-shape records the `[owner]` finding with its text and no `ask`, runs no role, and the run goes on to the next state. Fails first: no such option.
- `TestAcceptShapeOfABlockerAsksAFreeTextQuestion`: an `[owner blocker]` without options becomes a pause of kind `question` with the finding text and no `ask`, answered with an owner answer; no panic (`internal/engine/later.go:19-20`).
- `TestAcceptShapeRefusesOtherProblems`: a report with no `## Owner needed` section, or a gate with no verdict, is refused with one line saying that only an owner finding's missing options can be accepted.
- Guards: `TestAutomaticShapeRetryDoesNotUseARound` (`:190`) and `TestShapeProblemWithAQuestionStillPausesForTheOwner` (`:245`) pass unchanged.

In `internal/daemon/retry_test.go`: `TestRunRetryCarriesAcceptShape` (the wire flag reaches the engine) `TestPlainRetryAtTheShapeCapIsRefused` (owner decision 2026-11-05, Q1: the one-line refusal names `ork show RUN`, `ork retry RUN --accept-shape`, `ork retry RUN --again` and `ork stop RUN`) and `TestRetryAgainAtTheShapeCapRerunsTheRole` (`--again` reruns the role once; a further shape failure pauses capped again). In `internal/cli/retry_test.go`: `TestRetryAcceptShapeFlag` (parsed; `ork retry RUN TEXT --accept-shape` too) and `TestRetryAgainFlag` (parsed; `--again` with `--accept-shape` is a usage error).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first. Confirm each fails for the reason given.
2. In `parseOwnerQuestion`, keep one pass but return a typed cause: which rule, which line. Have `finding` turn it into one sentence that names the title and the cause, with the offending line cut to 120 characters. Leave the other two callers' prefix as it is.
3. Keep the offending finding's lines (cut to 2 KiB) beside the pending reason, and put them in the "Report shape" brief section under the reason, so a rerun that cannot resume its session still sees them (`internal/engine/round.go:143-144`).
4. Count consecutive shape pauses for the same role and round in the pending context (read from the context the retry started from, as `internal/engine/round.go:542` already reads it). Reset on any round that ends clean or with a different pause kind. At the cap (the second consecutive pause; owner decision 2026-11-05, Q4) build the pause reason as: the specific cause, the report file name, `ork show RUN`, and the way past: `ork retry RUN --accept-shape`, `ork retry RUN --again` or `ork stop RUN`. While the pause is capped, `MethodRunRetry` refuses a plain retry with that one line (owner decision 2026-11-05, Q1); `--again` reruns the role once on purpose.
5. Add the way past (owner decision 2026-11-05: only with `--accept-shape`, never by default, Q2): `RetryNote` with accept-shape re-reads the refused report, applies the lenient rule only to owner findings that failed on their options, and records them (non-blocker: finding with no `ask`; blocker: free-text question). Any other shape problem refuses. It spends no role round.
6. Do not change the prompts or the parser's rules; S288 does that and lands first (owner decision 2026-11-05, Q3). Build the typed cause of step 2 on the parser as S288 leaves it, and do not change `CheckReport`'s other rules.
7. Docs and CHANGELOG in the same diff. *Proposed* CHANGELOG line under `## Unreleased`: "A report-shape pause names what is wrong with an owner finding and quotes the line; the rerun's brief carries that finding's text; the second shape pause in a row for one role and round names the refused report and `ork retry RUN --accept-shape` (S298)." *Proposed* docs: `docs/design.md:570-584` (Report checks: the specific error, the counter and the cap), `docs/state.md` (the counter field on `pending`), `docs/guide.md:408` (the shape row: `ork show RUN` and `--accept-shape`).

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): How should this slice's orchestrator-only Check lines say who runs them and when they are done? -> tighten: replace the `go test ... -run 'Shape|Owner|Retry|Triage'` line with `go -C WORKTREE test -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli` (no `|` pattern; done when it exits 0 with all tests passing). Reword the four Mutation lines as steps the implementer performs by hand: edit the code, run the named test and see it fail, then revert. Each names the one test that must go red. The `[HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND]` line stays with the owner..

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go -C WORKTREE test -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/cli -run 'Shape|Owner|Retry|Triage'`: all pass.
- `go -C WORKTREE test -race -count=1 ./...`, `go -C WORKTREE vet ./...`, `gofmt -l WORKTREE` (empty), `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- Mutation: never reset the counter on a clean round; `TestShapePauseCounterCountsConsecutivePausesOfOneRoleAndRound` goes red.
- Mutation: leave the brief with the title only; `TestShapeRetryBriefHoldsWithoutAResumableSession` goes red.
- Mutation: let accept-shape accept a missing `## Owner needed` section; `TestAcceptShapeRefusesOtherProblems` goes red.
- Mutation: let a plain retry through at the cap; `TestPlainRetryAtTheShapeCapIsRefused` goes red.
- [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] A reviewer report with a misnumbered option under an owner finding pauses with a message that names that line, a detail line after `Recommend:` no longer pauses (S288), and a second shape pause on the same role shows the report file name and the accept command.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "Shape pauses: name the defect, feed it back, cap the loop".

sections.heading: Open owner questions
sections.body: None open. The owner answered Q1 to Q4 on 2026-11-05 with the recommended options (refuse-plain-retry, never-by-default, s288-first, two); the lead records the decisions.
